title: ואדי מרר, מערות עין אבו מחמוד (Wadi Murrar, 'Ein Abu Mahmud Caves)
author: Y. Patrich, B. Arubas
location_note: Marl cliffs of tributaries of Wadi Murrar near 'Ein Abu Mahmud, c. 2 km east of Kibbutz Almog, c. 3.5 km south-west of Deir Hajla; north of Wadi Qumran and south of Jebel Qarantal, so outside the held cave areas of phase-2 plan section 7 (INFERENCE from the stated position).
notes: Hermit caves with chapels, incised crosses and Greek inscriptions, attributed to monks of the laura of Gerasimus.
